Test Scenario: The amendment form says what an important change does
Pre-conditions: frontend/index.html read as text
Test Steps: 1. Read the amend form's markup
Expected Result: The line about date, attendance or requirements being an important change is present

Test Scenario: The saved message mentions flagged arrangements only when there are some
Pre-conditions: app.js built in a vm with a stubbed apiRequest
Test Steps: 1. Run amendEvent with each reply
Expected Result: Changes saved; 1 arrangement flagged; 2 arrangements flagged

Acceptance Criterion: AC8 A booking request that changes requirements
Test Scenario: New venue requirements sent with a booking request count as an important change
Pre-conditions: An event with a confirmed booking, a rejected booking and an equipment request; the event is Confirmed
Test Steps: 1. The assigned Coordinator POSTs a booking with different venue_requirements
Expected Result: 201 with arrangements_flagged 2; value saved; status stays Confirmed; flags on the earlier booking and the equipment, not the new booking; one history row naming the field; important hook runs once

Acceptance Criterion: AC8 A booking request that changes no requirements
Test Scenario: A booking with no requirements, the same requirements or blank text leaves the event alone
Pre-conditions: An event with a confirmed booking, a rejected booking and an equipment request
Test Steps: 1. The assigned Coordinator POSTs a booking with each value
Test Data: Field left out; 'Main hall'; ' Main hall '; empty; spaces
Expected Result: 201 with arrangements_flagged 0; venue requirements unchanged; no flag, no history row, no hook

Test Scenario: A zoned time for the moment the event already has is routine, and a real zoned change is stored as Singapore wall time
Pre-conditions: An event in Under Review with a confirmed booking, a rejected booking and an equipment request; the start is 2099-03-10 14:00
Test Steps:
1. Amend to the same moment with +08:00
2. Amend to the same moment in UTC
3. Amend to a new time in UTC
Expected Result: The same moment: routine, no changed fields, no flags, no hooks, start unchanged. The new time: important, stored as 2099-05-01 10:00

Test Scenario: Blank text on an empty field is routine, while clearing a filled field is still important
Pre-conditions: An event in Under Review with a confirmed booking, a rejected booking and an equipment request
Test Steps:
1. Amend blank text onto an empty venue requirements field
2. Amend blank text onto a filled one
Test Data: Stored None or empty; sent empty or spaces
Expected Result: On an empty field: routine, no changed fields, no flags, no hooks. On a filled field: important, 2 flagged, stored as empty

Acceptance Criterion: AC1 Coordinator told of an amendment
Test Scenario: The assigned Coordinator is told which fields changed; nobody else is
Pre-conditions: An event with an assigned Coordinator, in Under Review for amend and Planning for change requests
Test Steps:
1. Amend attendance and purpose
2. Read notifications
Expected Result: One notice to coord naming the event and both fields; none to the Organiser or other Coordinator

Acceptance Criterion: AC1 No notice without a change
Test Scenario: No real change, nobody assigned or a refused amendment sends nothing
Pre-conditions: An event with an assigned Coordinator, in Under Review for amend and Planning for change requests
Test Steps:
1. Amend to the same value
2. Amend with no Coordinator
3. Amend in Planning
Expected Result: 200, 200 and 400 respectively, with no notice

Acceptance Criterion: AC2 Coordinator told of a change request
Test Scenario: The notice names the fields and the reason, to the assigned Coordinator only
Pre-conditions: An event with an assigned Coordinator, in Under Review for amend and Planning for change requests
Test Steps:
1. Raise a request
2. Read notifications
Expected Result: One notice to coord with both fields and the reason; none to anyone else

Acceptance Criterion: AC2 A refused request is silent
Test Scenario: A refused request adds no notice
Pre-conditions: An event with an assigned Coordinator, in Under Review for amend and Planning for change requests
Test Steps:
1. Raise with no difference
2. Raise a good one
3. Raise a second
Expected Result: 400, 201, 409; one notice in all

Test Scenario: Organiser and Coordinator each get the outcome with the reason
Pre-conditions: An event with an assigned Coordinator, in Under Review for amend and Planning for change requests
Test Steps:
1. Raise a request
2. Decide
Test Data: Approve and reject, reason Spoke to the venue
Expected Result: One notice each with the outcome, reason and field; none to the other Coordinator

Acceptance Criterion: AC3 A refused decision is silent
Test Scenario: A decision by the wrong Coordinator sends nothing
Pre-conditions: An event with an assigned Coordinator, in Under Review for amend and Planning for change requests
Test Steps:
1. Raise a request
2. Decide as another Coordinator
Expected Result: 403; no outcome notice

Test Steps:

2. GET /notifications as the Coordinator
